relations.name: ACQUIRED
relations.description: The head organization bought or took control of the tail organization.

relations.name: SUBSIDIARY_OF
relations.description: The head organization is owned or controlled by the tail organization.

relations.name: SUPPLIES
relations.description: The head organization provides goods or services to the tail organization.

relations.name: PARTNERS_WITH
relations.description: The two organizations have a declared partnership.

relations.name: EMPLOYED_BY
relations.description: The person works for the organization, in any role.

relations.name: FOUNDED
relations.description: The person founded or co-founded the organization.

relations.name: LOCATED_IN
relations.description: The entity is based in, headquartered in or takes place in the location.

relations.name: PRODUCES
relations.description: The organization makes or sells the product.

relations.name: PARTICIPATED_IN
relations.description: The person or organization took part in the event.

relations.name: DIAGNOSED_WITH
relations.description: The person has or was diagnosed with the condition.

relations.name: TAKES_MEDICATION
relations.description: The person takes or was prescribed the medication.

relations.name: TREATS
relations.description: The medication or procedure is used to treat the condition.
